conventions.coordinates: Geocentric apparent body-center RA/declination, true equator/equinox of date; actual planetary latitude retained
conventions.horizon: Geometric altitude zero; no refraction, observer parallax, limb, elevation or polar motion correction
conventions.time: Pinned IANA tzdata; explicit DST fold; Skyfield UTC/UT1/TT and IAU2000A; proleptic Gregorian 1851-2148
conventions.meridians: MC H=0, IC H=180; upper/lower passage need not be visible or overhead
conventions.branches: ASC increasing geometric altitude with hour angle; DSC decreasing. Grazing endpoints and geographic poles excluded from mapped branches
conventions.map: GeoJSON longitude/latitude; adaptive geographic linear interpolation, antimeridian split on analytic curve; tolerance is numerical, not symbolic orb
conventions.distance: Shortest spherical distance to angular semicircle closure on sphere R=6371.0088km; grazing/polar endpoints identified, not claimed rising/setting
conventions.relocation: Same absolute UTC; tropical longitude-sector houses; default Placidus software choice, six existing systems; |latitude|<60 verified chart scope, no polar fallback
conventions.uncertainty: Deterministic offsets +/- user minutes (0-60); no statistical confidence interval
